subject: Consulting Cohort Onboarding: scope, training cadence, and ops handoff
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <emartinez@rpconsulting.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-03 09:15 AM -0700
Subject: RP Consulting cohort — interest in Redwood partner onboarding

Hi Sergio / Camila,

Thanks again for the intro last week. RP Consulting is building an LLM practice for enterprise clients and we would like to formalize a cohort-based onboarding with Redwood for our consultant cadre (15 engineers + 5 solution architects).

High-level asks:
- A 4-week technical onboarding (model selection, sandbox provisioning, integration patterns)
- A compact SI playbook we can embed that includes troubleshooting runbooks and cost/latency knobs
- A train-the-trainer session so our internal leads can run future cohorts

I've attached a short partner survey that covers expected use cases and compliance questions (RP_Onboarding_Survey.pdf).

Can you share a sample enablement cadence and any prerequisites we should prepare (sandbox accounts, sample datasets, security checklist)? We are targeting a kickoff in the week of Sep 18.

Cheers,
Elena Martinez
VP, Partnerships — RP Consulting
elena.martinez@rpconsulting.com
+1 415 555 0198

Attachment: RP_Onboarding_Survey.pdf (application/pdf, 128 KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <emartinez@rpconsulting.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-03 10:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: RP Consulting cohort — interest in Redwood partner onboarding

Elena — thanks for the clear asks and the survey, this is very helpful.

Short answer: yes, we can run a 4-week cohort and set up a train-the-trainer program. Attached is a first-pass SI playbook and a skill matrix we typically use to size training (SI_Playbook_v1.pptx, skill_matrix.xlsx).

Proposed onboarding cadence (draft):
Week 0 (prep): sandbox provisioning, access + security review, baseline test prompts
Week 1: foundations — Redwood API, model variants, latency/cost tradeoffs, basic integration patterns
Week 2: engineering deep-dive — batching, KV cache patterns, quantization suggestions, infra implications for Dedicated vs Hosted
Week 3: advanced ops — rollout strategies, canary + fallback policies, observability (Console walkthrough)
Week 4: handoff & TOT (train-the-trainer) — runbooks, certification checklist, evaluation prompt sets

Action items for RP before kickoff:
- Complete the attached survey (you've sent it; thanks)
- Provide staging tenant details for sandbox provisioning or confirm Redwoods-managed sandbox
- Share an attendee list with roles and level of LLM experience

Operational notes:
- We recommend a 90-minute weekly instructor-led session + 2 lab hours and a shared workspace for labs.
- Pricing for partner cohorts is typically split as a professional-services uplift + usage during training; I’ll route a short estimate once we confirm scope.

Cc'ing Laura to help coordinate logistics and to own the enrollment / calendar invites.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Attachment: SI_Playbook_v1.pptx (presentation/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, 2.4 MB); skill_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 34 KB)

Date: 2028-09-03 11:12 AM -0700
Subject: Re: RP Consulting cohort — interest in Redwood partner onboarding

Thanks — copying internal ops runbook items here so we can triage pre-kickoff tasks.

Internal checklist (ops):
- Sandbox tenant provisioning: request from infra by 09/06 (hold 3 staging GPUs; ephemeral access)
- Access matrix: create RBAC for 20 RP users, role templates: consultant, lead, observer
- Training lab repos: create forked lab repo and populate with sample prompts + eval sets
- Certification exam: adapt our existing TOT rubric; draft due 09/08

I'll create a shared Drive folder and drop a training schedule template (link below). Laura, can you please handle calendar invites and DocuSign intake for the MSA questionnaire?

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Partner Programs — Redwood Inference

All — appreciate the quick turnaround and detailed cadence. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- We will provide the attendee roster by Friday (roles + seniority).
- Sandbox: we prefer Redwood-managed sandbox for speed, but can provide tenant details if you need to test connection policies.
- MSA / procurement: attaching a short list of procurement questions and the customer's MSA template we typically use (MSA_questions.pdf).

Also looping in Tom Sweeney from Atlas Systems — a pilot customer who will likely join the cohort. Tom, hi — we’re coordinating with Redwood to spin up an example integration for a customer-facing deployment.

Next steps from RP: share attendee roster; confirm preferred sandbox option; review initial playbook and return comments by 09/07.

Thanks,
Elena
